svg.title: Port crane operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as port crane operator, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A horizontal ribbed shipping container hangs level from two slings beneath a broad crane spreader. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
